name: wall-joint-corner
description: WALL-MITRE-JOINTS repro + verification. Orbit dollhouse, 13:00, lights on, realistic tier, deviceClass pinned capable. Looks DOWN at the bathroom-2 / service-yard junction at (5.765, 6.825) — where the 300 mm household-shelter ring wall `wall-int-bath2-hs` lands on the collinear `wall-int-mid-S` (100 mm) / `wall-int-hs-S` (300 mm) run — and at the household-shelter's own NE corner (8.215, 4.875), where two 300 mm interior partitions meet. Both are corners the pre-v0.35.4.0 outward-normal probe could not orient (rooms on BOTH sides of the neighbour), so they fell back to a buried butt: one wall's box runs through the other, the reveal fade shows two layers and a stepped end, and the skirting/crown seam is visible. Four frames: {mitre flag OFF = before, ON = after} x {oblique pose where the near walls FADE, high pose where they are OPAQUE}, plus a walk-mode kitchen eye-level frame. Each pose logs `window.__wallOpacities()` so the fade state is measured, not assumed. Run with SHOT_VIEWPORT=1200,900 and SHOT_GPU=1.

steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setCameraMode?.('orbit'); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false); s.hideLoading?.() })()
